conventions: Node positions are local to the listed parent (mesh-node positions include the meshopt dequantization offset; do not rely on them). glTF +Y up, barrel along +Z, meters. Root node = weapon id; origin at the firing-hand pistol grip. Children of the root: body (static mesh), plus pivot nodes mag and <cycle_node> (bolt | charging_handle | slide); each pivot node holds its mesh as child <name>_mesh. Animate the pivot node (mag: top of the mag well; bolt/charging_handle/slide: the handle; break-action bolt: hinge pin; Win94 bolt: lever pivot; R1895 bolt: hammer pivot, mag: cylinder axis). Empties: muzzle, grip_support (support hand), sight_eye (eye point on the iron-sight line), rail_top (optic mount point, top of rail/receiver; omitted where nothing can mount).
